notes.title: Projected Dreams OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers,

Three weeks ago, we announced the release date of Projected Dreams, and time has gone by so quickly since then.
Without rambling on, we are so incredibly proud to announce that our debut game, Projected Dreams, is OUT NOW on Steam!

Thank you so much to everyone who has stuck with us from the beginning, three years ago, until now! Regardless of how the launch goes, we’re extremely proud of what we’ve created and can’t wait for you to check it out!

If chill and puzzle games are your jam, please check out our bundles!

 Projected Dreams x Simpler Times
 Projected Dreams x ODDADA
 Sit Back and Relax Bundle (Projected Dreams, SCHiM, Sticky Business, Inbento, and Sizable)

Alternatively, check out our supporter pack containing 31(!!) original soundtracks by our sound and music genius, Floris Demandt!

Please leave a review as soon as you can! This helps us to push the Steam algorithm a bit!

Once again, thank you for supporting a small studio like ours! It means the world to us!
We hope you enjoy Projected Dreams as much as we enjoyed making it! <3

Love always,
Flawberry Studio

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Demo Update!
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers

IT'S TIME!
Projected Dreams is part of the Steam Next Fest from the 24th of February to the 3rd of March!

While Steam Next Fest will (hopefully) give us some visibility, we'll also be able to fix any bugs you might find. So be sure to send them to our bug report section on our Discord. 

Participating in the Steam Next Fest also means that the actual release of the game is not too far away! In fact, we're aiming to release Projected Dreams this spring! Wohooo!

This means that if you haven't already done so, add the game to your wishlist to be notified when it launches!

(Pssst... we're also running a full game key giveaway on our Twitter and Discord! So be sure to check it out)

Onto the newest additions in this demo:


 Added start cutscene
 Added new levels to the theatre room
 Improved visuals in the photo album
 Added hints in the book
 Added new music and sfx
 Improved level grading in some difficult levels
 Polished a bunch of visuals
 Fixed a lot of bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes – Demo Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

I hope you are all well and enjoying the summer to the fullest!
As for us, we've been working hard on our little cozy puzzler for you!

Celebrate a new update with us!

We’ve been accepted into the first Wholesome Games Celebration Festival! My inner child was doing little jumps of joy when we got the news that Projected Dreams was accepted!

So, to celebrate the occasion, we've decided to release another update to our demo, specifically addressing some of the issues and bugs that the community has mentioned. 

Major improvements include the following:


 Added new levels to the theatre
 Improved visuals in the photo album
 Added the first version of the hint system (toggle in menu)
 Added new music and sfx (removed the creepy ones)
 Improved level grading in some difficult levels
 Polished a bunch of visuals
 Fixed a lot of bugs


Let us know what you think of the new update! If you find a bug or have a specific request, please feel free to join our Discord and report these things there!

Don't forget to check out the wholesome celebration on Steam! There you can find lots of demos, new games, and even some discounted games!

notes.title: Celebrating a new Demo Update!
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers,

To celebrate our participation in the Cozy Celebration event, we've decided to release a major update to our demo!  As all these improvements are quite big, let me break them down for you:

The biggest addition is the theatre room! Introducing a completely new mechanic which lets you overlap shadows through its two light sources!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/8c7491087e37b416db08801a6cc075c635b13464.jpg

Introducing the photo album, which drives the narrative and also acts as a level selection! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/2ba35bbea297e8f70a0049bed915847b0ecf67e0.jpg

New grading system added! The more accurate you are at solving each puzzle, the more hearts you will receive! This means that if you're just playing for the story, you can move on as soon as you reach one heart! Or for the completionists among you, you can try to get all three hearts in all the levels!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/c26674d74e2dae333d29f75cc0c73c8e95dfff30.jpg

We've hidden some music cassettes in some levels! When you find them, you can drag them into the tape recorder and listen to some funky or chilly tunes ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/8ddc5ad5d6fc7044882f3d55c562ddad80614be5.jpg

We removed the space station!
As we're currently reworking the entire space station, we've decided to remove it from the demo and add it back once the entire room has been reworked and the photo-illustrations are complete.

That's is for now! Let us know what you think of the demo so far!
We're planning to update the demo more often now!
And don't forget to add Projected Dreams to your wishlist <3

Flawberry Studio

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/e34447e5e1bfa65c6923c0ee1b0dff394932d6ab.png

notes.title: Ready to test Projected Dreams?
notes.content:
We've been working on Projected Dreams for about a year and a half now, showing demo after demo at various events like Zurich PopCon and Fantasy Basel. We are now at a point where we can confidently release the first beta demo of Projected Dreams for a limited time to gather feedback and new ideas for the game!

During October, we will be exhibiting the demo at this year's Zurich PopCon, EGX London, and Herofest!

We're super excited to hear what you think about the beta so far, so please let us know if you found any bugs, have any new ideas, and more!

There's more!

Since this is the beta demo, the final version will have a lot more to offer. We have a few things planned that we talked about on our Discord, but let me list them here as well:

The storybook
This book can be used as the main menu of the game. By flipping through the pages, you can choose which level or setting you want to replay. It also summarizes the main story and may even hide some levels you need to find first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/9ef30aeb5ecd9be024e85aafe200122e061d055e.png

This is a super early screenshot as we are mainly working on the level selection right now. Other things we'd like to add are:

- Animated, new chapter selection illustrations
- Fleshed out story told through the book and shadow silhouettes
- Ability to find hidden levels inside the book
- Level rating to encourage replayability

The Story
While we can't say much about the story yet, this part will be completely reworked in the current demo. We plan to give our main character Senka much more depth. 

If you want to give us feedback and support the development of our game, feel free to join our Discord server to talk about all things cozy and nostalgic and give feedback!

Love always,
Flawberry Studio
